title: Playwright proves Qwen and example pages speak
description:
## Behavior

Kokoro basic and the home pitch already require a playable clip of real duration. Qwen, themed, and ignore only assert the POST body, so a tone stub or a hung player would still pass CI.

```gherkin
Feature: Example pages demonstrate distinct speech
  Scenario: Qwen example audio is spoken-length
    Given the Qwen example page
    When the player has a playable clip
    Then audio duration is at least twenty seconds

  Scenario: Themed and ignore examples also speak
    Given those example pages
    When each player has a playable clip
    Then audio duration is at least eight seconds
```

## Implementation brief

1. `site/tests/acceptance.spec.ts` — after the existing POST asserts, `waitForPlayableClip` + `clipDurationSeconds` on `/examples/qwen` (>= 20), `/examples/themed` (>= 8), and `/examples/ignore` (>= 8).
2. Do not enable PyPI.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Merged PR #41. Qwen (>=20s), themed, and ignore (>=8s) now require a playable clip. Also unblocked develop CI by catching Batch describe errors as BotoCoreError/ClientError.

right_now_summary: Playwright now checks that Qwen, themed, and ignore examples produce spoken-length audio.
